detail.title: NC281 Gaming Laptop Cooling Pad - Carbon Black
detail.overview: The Ant Esports NC281 features two large 110mm turbo external fans delivering 360-degree surrounding cooling with no air leakage, built for laptops up to 17.2 inches. A real-time LED display shows exact fan speed, with adjustable buttons letting you fine-tune the balance between cooling efficiency and noise instantly. Double non-slip baffles securely anchor the laptop in place, while 5 adjustable height positions reduce neck strain during extended use. Ten RGB lighting modes add a striking gaming atmosphere, and a detachable cell phone holder keeps a smartphone accessible without cluttering the desk. Built with durable ABS plastic and a diamond-shaped metal design, the NC281 combines strong cooling performance with genuine visual appeal.
